scope: Lexical sustained healing/repair/zone/pulse/turn candidates, including exclusions and already reviewed regeneration; no semantic completeness claim.

card.name: Consecrated Ground
card.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

source.originalText: Consecrated Ground: Healing allies on terrain you sanctify (via Rite) heals for +10%.

card.name: Radiance
card.frequency: Automatic only if Radiance was selected
card.effect: Invocation Path — Radiance. Tags: invocation, radiance, healing. Once on each of your turns when one of your Rites restores HP to at least one living creature, choose one creature healed by that Rite. It regains S additional HP and may immediately end either Frightened or Poisoned on itself.

source.originalText: Radiance: +10% healing power and heals cleanse minor conditions.

card.name: Echoes
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most one pending Echoes-path repeat
card.effect: Invocation Path — Echoes. Tags: invocation, echoes. Once on each of your turns after a Smite or Rite produces rolled immediate damage or healing, store one original target and that raw dice total. At the start of your next regular turn, if the target is legal, repeat floor(raw dice total/10), minimum 1 for a positive total, as the same damage or healing type. This repeat carries no conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Echoes: 10% of healing or damage is repeated 1 turn later (Echo Effect).

card.name: Sacred Chant
card.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. Under the base feature, the third pulse generates 1 Conviction. Only a real encounter can generate Conviction this way. Maintenance itself does not otherwise heal, damage or grant Conviction.

source.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

card.name: Aura of Faith
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 feet who can perceive you
card.effect: Aura of Faith. Tags: aura, bishop. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saving throws. Whenever your Rite restores HP to an ally in the aura, that ally also regains 1 additional HP. Multiple Aura of Faith bonuses do not stack.

source.originalText: Aura of Faith: Allies in range gain +5% healing received and +1 to saves.

card.name: Divine Invocation
card.effect: Divine Invocation. Tags: invocation, bishop. Use only your selected Invocation Path. Radiance: up to 3 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP; one may end Frightened or Poisoned. Judgment: one enemy within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also applies Judged for 2 rounds. Renewal: up to 2 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP and 5 Stamina. Flame: creatures in a 15-foot cone make Dexterity saves, taking (S+1)d8 fire on failure or half on success; failed targets also take 1d6 fire at the start of their next turn. Veil: up to 3 allies within 30 feet can see invisible/ethereal creatures within 30 feet and gain advantage on saves against illusions for 3 rounds. Echoes: choose one eligible Smite or Rite you resolved this turn or previous regular turn and one original target within 30 feet; repeat 50% of its immediate unmodified rolled damage or healing dice, rounded down once, minimum 1 for a positive source, with no copied conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Divine Invocation: Channel a powerful prayer based on your chosen Invocation Path, with effects ranging from mass healing to divine fire or protective barriers.

card.name: Aura of Grace
card.frequency: Healing once/own regular turn; critical reduction once/ally/round
card.effect: Aura of Grace. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, you may pay 1 RP to heal S HP to up to 3 living allies within 15 ft below half maximum HP. You must be conscious. Separately, once per ally per round when an ally in the aura suffers a critical hit, reduce its added critical damage by one damage die, minimum 0 extra dice. No unlimited free healing.

source.originalText: Aura of Grace: Allies in range resist critical hits and gain minor HP regen.

card.name: Balanced Scales
card.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures healed by your Cleric features
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per marked ally per round
card.effect: Balanced Scales. Tags: priest, healing, retaliation. After you restore HP to a living ally, mark it until the start of your next regular turn. The first enemy to damage that ally during the mark takes S + M radiant damage. The retaliation is not an attack, cannot critically hit and cannot recursively trigger another Balanced Scales event.

source.originalText: Balanced Scales: Enemies take divine damage if they attack healed targets.

card.name: Word of Power
card.effect: Word of Power. Tags: priest, divine. Choose one mode. Mercy: one willing living creature regains S d8+M HP. Rebuke: one Undead or Fiend makes a Constitution save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also removes its Reaction until the start of its next turn. Command: one other hostile creature makes a Wisdom save; failure knocks it Prone and removes its Reaction until the start of its next turn. No mode changes beliefs, loyalty or ideology.

source.originalText: Word of Power: Speak a divine word that has different effects based on the target's nature and actions.

card.name: Cosmic Equilibrium
card.effect: Cosmic Equilibrium. Tags: priest, zone, healing, radiant. Once per round, when a living ally in the zone receives healing beyond its missing HP, redirect up to S+M of that excess as radiant damage to one enemy in the zone. Separately, once per round when an enemy in the zone takes radiant damage from one of your Cleric features, one ally in the zone regains up to S+M HP, not exceeding half the actual radiant damage dealt. These two conversions cannot trigger each other.

source.originalText: Cosmic Equilibrium: Create a zone where healing and harm are balanced, converting excess damage to healing and vice versa.

card.name: Sanguine Rite
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and one ally within 30 feet
card.frequency: At most once on each of your turns
card.effect: Sanguine Rite. Tags: cultist, rite, healing. When one of your Rites deals damage to at least one enemy, choose one living ally within 30 feet. That ally regains HP equal to half the actual damage dealt to one chosen damaged enemy, rounded down, maximum S+M HP. This healing cannot trigger Sanguine Rite again.

source.originalText: Sanguine Rite:  Rites damage enemies and heal allies for a portion of the same amount.

card.name: Blasphemous Tongue
card.duration: Until the next Sacrament pulse or effect end
card.effect: Blasphemous Tongue. Tags: cultist, sacrament, doomed. At each pulse of your Sacrament, each enemy affected by that pulse makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Doomed until the next pulse. While Doomed, HP healing it receives is reduced by S+M, minimum 0, and each positive timed buff on it counts down one additional round at the end of its turn. Repeated failures refresh rather than stack.

source.originalText: Blasphemous Tongue: Sacraments inflict Doomed, reducing healing received and buff duration.

card.name: Zealot's Touch
card.effect: Zealot's Touch. Tags: cultist, rite, necrotic. When starting a Rite whose printed pulse would restore HP over multiple turns, you may designate a hostile creature instead of a healing recipient. At each applicable pulse that enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes necrotic damage equal to the Rite's rolled healing dice; on success it takes half. Flat healing bonuses are not converted. The enemy receives no healing.

source.originalText: Zealot's Touch: Healing over time effects become life drain if cast on enemies.

card.name: Dark Sacrament
card.cost: 3 Conviction + 5 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance
card.effect: Dark Sacrament. Tags: cultist, sacrament, rite, sustained, zone. On start and each paid maintenance pulse, roll S d6 once. Up to three enemies in the zone make Constitution saves, taking that roll as necrotic damage on failure or half on success. If at least one enemy takes damage, up to three living allies in the zone each regain floor(roll/2)+M HP. Maximum 3 pulses. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Dark Sacrament: Perform a twisted ritual that drains life from enemies to heal allies or create other beneficial effects.

card.name: Zealot's Fervor
card.effect: Zealot's Fervor. Tags: cultist, stance. For 3 rounds, once on each of your turns add S to one damage roll from a Cleric feature and S to one HP-healing roll from a Cleric feature. While the Fervor lasts, your AC is reduced by 1. The Conviction expenditure is not a Rite or Invocation and therefore does not vent Dissonance by itself.

source.originalText: Zealot's Fervor: Enter a state of religious frenzy, increasing your damage output and healing power at the cost of defense.

classRecords.text: Your Bleed is a physical ongoing effect on a living, non-bloodless creature: 1d4 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, then ends. It is not a new attack and generates no BG or procs. Refresh duration instead of stacking; Blood Echo expressly allows two independent instances, maximum. An Action by the victim or an adjacent creature using a healer's kit ends all your Bleeds on that victim. Apply physical resistance/immunity normally. Track remaining ticks and creator per instance. Allied healing versions from Bloodweaver cost RP and never count as hostile Bleeds for detonation, spreading or generation.

card.name: Hemostasis
card.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally in range of your Bleed application
card.effect: You may replace a new Bleed application on that ally with healing 1d4 at start of its next 3 turns. Pay extra RP even if original application was free. One such healing effect per target; it cannot spread, detonate, generate BG or trigger healing loops.

source.originalText: Hemostasis: Bleeds applied to allies now heal them instead.

card.name: Lifewell
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies within 15 ft
card.effect: Spend K BG. At start and on each of your next 2 turns, use Bonus Action and pay 1 RP to pulse healing: each chosen ally still within 15 ft regains 1d8+K HP. Without maintenance it ends at turn end. Total 3 pulses; no triggers create more BG.

source.originalText: Lifewell: Ultimate ability that converts all your remaining Blood Gauge into a powerful healing aura for allies.

classRecords.text: Spending Momentum pays before resolution; a hit refund cannot pay its own activation. Burn means 1d4 fire at start of target's next 2 turns, nonstacking. Bleed means 1d4 physical at start of next 2 turns; an Action with a healer's kit ends it. Do Ts give no Momentum or critical triggers. Hard denial uses the shared once-per-target/encounter guard.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

card.name: Reality Fracture
card.effect: While you stand inside, once/turn add 1d6 to one Echo damage/healing amount or impose-1 on one target's Echo save. Choose before resolving. No free releases, random recasts, resource refunds or extra targets.

source.originalText: Reality Fracture: Create a zone where Echo abilities are enhanced and have a chance to trigger additional effects.

card.name: Fractured Dominion
card.effect: Your first damage release on each of these 2 turns adds one half-dice component against a DIFFERENT enemy within 10 ft of an original target. Same package and shared copy cap; excludes healing/control. Never recursively copies a copy or adds a release action.

source.originalText: Final – Fractured Dominion: For 2 turns, every Echo cast also generates a Glitched Clone Echo that strikes a nearby enemy.

card.name: Crane Stance (Support)
card.cost: 0 for stance; healing costs 1 Ki and 1 RP
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 15 feet for healing rider
card.effect: Crane Stance. Tags: stance, support. While unarmored, whenever you move at least 15 feet on your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. HP healing you receive from another creature gains +S HP once per round. When you begin an unarmed strike at exactly 5 Ki and hit, spend 1 Ki and 1 RP; you and one living ally within 15 feet each regain S+M HP, at most once per turn.

source.originalText: Crane Stance (Support): +10% healing received. Moving 3+ tiles grants +15% dodge. At 5 Ki, next strike heals self and ally.

card.name: Breath of the Thousand Petals
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to six allies within 20 feet
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Final — Breath of the Thousand Petals. Tags: hero, enlightened, final, resurrection, weave. Living or Downed allies in range regain 3 S d8+M HP. Up to two allied creatures that died since the end of your previous regular turn return to life at 1 HP if their bodies can sustain life. Until the start of your next turn, affected living allies cannot be reduced below 1 HP by damage, though instant-death effects still function. It removes no Wounds and cannot revive the same creature twice.

source.originalText: Final – Breath of the Thousand Petals: AoE revive and death immunity (1 round).

card.name: Circle of Harmony
card.cost: 2 Ki + 3 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance
card.effect: Circle of Harmony. Tags: hero, enlightened, healing, zone, weave, sustained. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, up to three living allies in the zone regain S d6+M HP. Maximum 3 pulses. A creature receives this named effect at most once per round. It removes no Wounds and cannot restore the dead.

source.originalText: Circle of Harmony: Create a zone of balanced energy that gradually restores health to allies within it.

card.name: Transcendent Meditation
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to three allies within 15 feet
card.effect: Transcendent Meditation. Tags: hero, enlightened, healing, weave, sustained. On start and at the start of each of your next two regular turns while concentration holds, each target regains S d6 HP. You regain 1 Ki on the second pulse only, never above 5. Targets must remain within 15 feet. This finite healing cannot be restarted until the short-rest use refreshes.

source.originalText: Transcendent Meditation: Enter a deep meditative state that dramatically accelerates healing for yourself and nearby allies.

classRecords.text: Oracle zone default: choose at most three allies and three enemies for each pulse or aura benefit, fixed at activation unless the card names fewer. Persistent damaging/healing zones require concentration and at most three pulses. Pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first, or end the effect; once-per-long-rest Finals include their printed pulses in that limited use. One pulse can affect a creature only once per round. Passive personal resistance and a single-target temporary buff are not zones.

card.name: Spiral-Touched — Boon III
card.duration: Until start of next regular turn
card.effect: 1/long rest when damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, instead regain floor(max HP/4), minimum 1, and phase out until the start of your next regular turn; while phased you cannot be targeted, affect other creatures or activate Revelations.

value.name: Spiral-Touched
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations
You occasionally experience time differently than others, potentially missing turns in combat (5% chance)
You cannot maintain concentration on mundane tasks for extended periods

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: You gain the ability to create a time loop, resetting an entire combat encounter to its beginning state once per day. All allies retain knowledge of the original timeline, allowing them to make different choices.

value.source: rulebook — Example Curse: Spiral-Touched (only full curse tree in player rulebook)

card.name: Wound Eater — Boon IV
card.cost: 2 RC start; 1 RC per later pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three living enemies within 10 feet
card.effect: pay 2 RC as a Bonus Action to activate a 10-foot drain aura, requiring concentration for at most three pulses; pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first or end it. You may suppress it freely. During a real encounter, at the start of your turn up to three meaningful living enemies in the aura takes S necrotic damage; regain HP equal to the total actually dealt, capped at S+M per turn.

value.name: Wound Eater
value.blurb: Lives by wounds taken from the living, never by an easy cure
limitations: Natural healing and healing granted by another restore only half their usual amount to you
Before each long rest ends, you must drain life from a living foe or gain Exhaustion
Your flesh carries a hollow, withered look that makes many mortals recoil at first meeting

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: When you hit a living foe with a weapon or touch attack, drain 1d6 HP; you heal for half the amount drained. Undead and constructs are immune.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: When you reduce a living foe to 0 HP, regain 1 Revelation Charge. Resistance to necrotic damage from non-Revelation sources.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Once per short rest, siphon a dying enemy's remaining HP as a burst heal (up to 25% of your max HP). The Pale Ledger records their final breath.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Drain aura: at the start of your turn, living enemies within 2 tiles take necrotic damage; you heal for the total drained. You may suppress this aura in civilized areas.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a conduit of the unfinished hunger — all living enemies within 4 tiles lose 25% max HP; you heal for half the total. Allies are unaffected.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Burning Blood — Boon V
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; up to three enemies/allies within 15 feet
card.effect: 1/long rest as a Bonus Action become a living pyre for 3 rounds. At the start of each hostile creature's turn within 15 feet it takes S d6 fire damage. Once per your turn when at least one enemy takes fire damage from you, regain 1d6 HP, capped at S+M HP per turn. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and hidden/invisible creatures within 10 feet cannot benefit from mundane darkness or visual concealment against creatures illuminated by your pyre.

value.name: Burning Blood
value.blurb: Air kindles your spilled blood into a fire that harms friend and foe alike
limitations: When slashing or piercing damage wounds you, you and adjacent foes take 1d4 fire damage as your blood sparks
You cannot benefit from cold-based healing or resistances; your curse rejects the chill
Open wounds glow faintly, imposing −2 to Stealth until treated or until you rest

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Resistance to fire. Melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage when they hit you with a weapon attack. Your wounds smolder briefly — enemies within 1 tile take 1 fire damage when your blood first ignites each round.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to ignite your blood — your next Revelation deals +50% fire damage and cannot be extinguished by mundane means. While ignited, slashing and piercing damage against you no longer sparks fire on adjacent allies; the Crown's flame answers only to your will.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When your blood ignites from damage, allies within 2 tiles gain +10% weapon damage for 1 round as shard-fire answers your pain. You may extend the flare to 3 tiles by spending 1 Revelation Charge — enemies in the burst take 1d4 fire damage as embers leap from your wounds.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Blood flare: when reduced below 50% HP, erupt fire in a 3-tile burst (once per short rest). Enemies take fire damage; you are not harmed by your own flare.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a living pyre for 3 rounds — fire aura in 3 tiles; enemies take fire damage at start of turn; you heal 1d6 when an enemy takes fire damage from you. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and treat your ignited blood as bright light that reveals hidden foes within 2 tiles.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Consumed — Boon V
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to three allies within 10 feet
card.effect: 1/long rest as a Bonus Action fully embody your Mystery for 3 rounds. Gain immunity to the theme damage type, +2 on Revelation attack rolls and Revelation save DC, and add S to one Revelation damage or healing roll each turn. Allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC. Visible transformation cannot be suppressed during this embodiment.

value.name: Consumed
value.blurb: Your Mystery remakes your body until its element shows through
limitations: As you gain levels, your appearance shifts toward your Mystery's theme: flame hair, starlit eyes, bone protrusions, and the like
Some civilized NPCs react with fear or awe; concealing the change in formal courts requires ongoing effort
As your body changes, armor and gear must be refitted periodically (roleplay / downtime cost)

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Gain +5% resistance aligned with your Mystery's element or theme (fire, necrotic, force, psychic, etc.). Once per day, suppress visible transformation for 1 hour in civilized areas — the Mystery still leaks through divination.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Elemental skin: +1 AC while wearing light or no armor as your flesh hardens into mystery-matter. Unarmed strikes and natural weapons you wield count as magical and deal +1d4 thematic damage.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Mystery infusion: weapon and touch attacks deal +1d4 thematic damage matching your Mystery. Revelation potency visibly bleeds into your strikes.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Partial transformation: ignore difficult terrain tied to your Mystery (fire walks, shadow steps, temporal stutter, etc.). Allies who follow within 1 tile during the same round may treat that terrain as normal ground until your next turn.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, fully embody your Mystery's element for 3 rounds — immunity to that damage type, +2 effective Revelation potency, and visible manifestation (aura, wings of flame, star corona, etc.). Allies within 2 tiles gain +1 AC as your transformation steadies the battlefield; suppression is impossible while the embodiment lasts.

value.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

card.name: Rotting Touch
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it gains Decay for up to 3 rounds: attacks against it add S damage once per attacker per turn, it takes -1 on saving throws and cannot regain HP. At the end of each turn it repeats the save, ending Decay on success. Corpses within 2 tiles of a Decayed creature cannot be raised while Decay persists. If the target is undead, it also takes 2d6 necrotic damage on the initial hit and you regain half the actual damage dealt, capped at S+M HP. At most three allied hits per round receive the vulnerability rider; it is additional flat damage, not multiplication of an entire attack.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Rotting Touch
value.description: Spend 2 charges: touch attack inflicts Decay — target takes +25% damage from all sources and −10% saves for 3 rounds; the Pale Ledger tallies their rot — on a failed save they also cannot regain HP and corpses within 2 tiles of them cannot be raised as undead until Decay ends; if the target is undead, they take 2d6 necrotic immediately and you heal half.

card.name: Unfinished Chorus
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemies, controlled undead and corpses within 4 tiles
card.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. Once on each of your turns choose one living enemy in range; it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you either regain half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, or one living ally within 3 tiles of you regains that amount, maximum S+M HP. Undead you control add S damage to one attack each turn and reduce first damage each round by 1. Corpses in the area cannot be raised while the Chorus lasts. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet. Choose up to three enemies and three allies. Enemies make Wisdom saves on entry and at the end of each turn, ending their debuff on success. The drain allows a Constitution save for half damage; healing is capped at S+M total per pulse. Concentration and pulse upkeep apply.

value.name: Unfinished Chorus
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) as the Pale Ledger sings their unfinished deaths — once per round drain 1d6 HP from one target (heal half or redirect half to an ally within 3 tiles); undead you control gain +10% damage and +5% DR, and corpses within 4 tiles cannot be raised as undead until the chorus ends. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% necrotic resist for 1 round).

card.name: Zealot's Renewal
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.rangeAndTarget: One living ally within 3 tiles; adjacent enemies
card.duration: Instantaneous; fire ward until start of your next turn
card.effect: The ally regains 2 S d8+M HP, then takes 1d4 fire backlash that cannot be reduced below 1 unless First Flame Convergence suppresses it. It may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Until the start of your next turn it reduces the first fire damage it takes by S. Hostile creatures adjacent to the healed ally take 1d4 fire damage once from scattering embers.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Zealot's Renewal
value.description: Spend 2 charges: one ally within 3 tiles regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier × level tier (minimum 1d8) but takes 1d4 fire backlash — wrathful healing; the Crown's embers cling — they end one minor poison or disease, gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn, and adjacent enemies take 1d4 fire as cursed ash scatters from the renewal.

card.name: First Flame Convergence
card.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a Flame Revelation deals fire damage, add one extra die matching that Revelation's primary damage die to one damage roll. Once per turn when one of your Flame Revelations damages a meaningful hostile creature, one living ally within 4 tiles regains 1d6 HP. Allies within 4 tiles are immune to Frightened. Once per turn when this effect heals an ally, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Zealot's Renewal deals no backlash while Convergence lasts.

value.name: First Flame Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, your fire Revelations deal +25% damage and allies within 4 tiles heal 1d6 when you burn an enemy — you emit warm light and allies are immune to fear; the Crown's memory kindles: once per turn when you heal via wrathful fire, one ally within 4 tiles gains +5% DR until start of your next turn, and Zealot's Renewal backlash is suppressed during the convergence.

card.name: Crown Restored
card.effect: Manifest the Crown for 3 rounds. Once on each of your turns add 2 fire damage to one damaging attack or Revelation. At the start of each living ally's turn within 5 tiles, including yours, that ally regains 1d6 HP, at most three pulses per creature from this Final and never above maximum HP. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Flame Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. Free Revelations cannot recursively restore additional RC beyond the normal once-per-round Prophecy Trigger cap.

value.name: Crown Restored
value.description: Once per day, manifest the Crown of First Flame for 3 rounds: +2 fire damage on all attacks, allies within 5 tiles regenerate 1d6 per round, and you may cast Tier I fire Revelations at 0 cost once per round.

card.name: Resonant Seed
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
card.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Resonant Seed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

card.name: Garden of Restoration
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Garden at a time
card.effect: At the start of each living ally's turn in the Garden, it regains 1d6 HP, maximum three pulses per creature from this use, and gains +1 HP the next time another finite healing effect restores HP before its next turn. The first time each ally enters or starts in a given Garden, it may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Undead starting in the Garden take 1d6 radiant damage and make a Wisdom save; on failure they take -1 on attack rolls until the end of that turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Garden of Restoration
value.description: Spend 2 charges: bloom a 4-tile garden of restoration for 3 rounds — allies inside regenerate 1d6 at start of turn and gain +5% healing received; undead inside take 1d6 radiant at start of turn and must save or suffer −10% hit; entering the garden ends one minor poison or disease on that ally (once each per garden).

card.name: Verdant Pulse
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies you heal; emergency ally within 4 tiles
card.duration: Buff until end of ally's next turn; emergency instantaneous
card.frequency: Buff once per ally per short rest; emergency 1/encounter
card.effect: When one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to an ally who was below half maximum HP, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before the end of its next turn by S and adds 1 HP to one later finite healing effect during that period. Separately, once per encounter when a living ally within 4 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP without instant death, use your Reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead and end Frightened or Poisoned on it.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Verdant Pulse
value.description: Passive: when you heal an ally below 50% HP, they gain +10% resistances and +5% healing received until end of next turn (once per ally per short rest). Once per combat, when an ally within 4 tiles would drop to 0 HP, a verdant pulse blooms — they stabilize at 1 HP and end one minor condition.

card.name: Song of Mending
card.effect: On activation and at the start of your next regular turn, each living ally still within 5 tiles regains 2d6 HP, for exactly two possible pulses per use. Once during the duration for each ally, when one damage event would reduce it below 1 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. When this prevention triggers, that ally may end Frightened or Poisoned and gains +S HP the next time a separate finite healing effect restores HP before Song ends. This removes no Wounds and cannot resurrect.

value.name: Song of Mending
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all allies within 5 tiles regenerate 2d6 at start of turn and cannot be reduced below 1 HP by a single hit (once each) — the Verdant Resonance sings through them; when an ally is stabilized by this song, they end one minor condition and gain +10% healing received until the song ends.

card.name: Life Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Overflowing Light: maximum temporary HP from excess healing becomes 20. Enhanced Garden of Restoration: the first Garden pulse a creature receives may end both Poisoned and one disease that explicitly allows magical curing, rather than only one of those benefits. Enhanced Song of Mending: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains one additional 2d6 healing pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; each ally still receives only one 1-HP death prevention per use.

value: Enhanced Overflowing Light: temp HP max 20
Enhanced Garden of Restoration: also removes poison/disease on entry
Enhanced Song of Mending: duration 3 turns

card.name: Eternal Bloom
card.effect: When Eternal Bloom appears, record each living ally's missing HP while it is inside the zone. Divide that recorded missing HP into three healing installments as evenly as possible, with any remainder assigned to earlier pulses. On activation and at the start of each of your next two regular turns, each qualifying ally still inside regains its next installment; later damage does not increase this reserve. Once per ally during the Bloom, when damage would reduce it to 0 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. Allies in the zone have necrotic immunity for the 3 rounds. When the Bloom ends, petals create light obscurement in the zone until the start of your next turn. It removes no Wounds and does not resurrect.

value.name: Eternal Bloom
value.description: Once per day, raise a sanctuary bloom for 3 rounds in a 5-tile zone — allies inside are stabilized at 1 HP instead of dying, heal fully over the duration, and gain immunity to necrotic. Ends with petals scattering (brief obscurement).

card.name: Rewind Wound
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.duration: Healing instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; same damage event can be rewound once
card.effect: Reference the most recent single damage event the target suffered since the start of its previous regular turn and restore HP equal to that event's actual HP damage, maximum Oracle level+M. If that exact event directly imposed one condition with a finite duration, remove that condition if it is still present and is not a Wound, curse, death state or permanent transformation. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1 and gains +2 initiative for the current round. If the recorded damage had reduced it below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round. Rewind does not undo attacks, spent resources, movement, deaths of other creatures or proc effects.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Rewind Wound
value.description: Spend 2 charges: touch ally within 1 tile — the Turning Spiral folds causality; undo the last instance of damage they took in the past round (restore HP, remove one condition inflicted by that hit if any); they gain +5% DR and +2 initiative until start of your next turn, and if the undone damage would have dropped them below half HP, you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

card.name: The Spiral Opens
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; one known beneficial Time Revelation or one enemy within 5 tiles
card.effect: For 3 rounds, at the start of each of your regular turns choose ONE temporal option, each usable at most once during this Final. ECHO REVELATION: repeat only the immediate numeric damage, healing, movement or buff component of one beneficial Time Revelation you personally resolved during the previous round, paying 0 RC; this copy is not a new Revelation cast, copies no resource restoration, action grant, hard control, condition trigger, Prophecy Trigger or proc. FORCED ECHO: choose one non-player enemy within 5 tiles and one ordinary weapon attack or non-resource movement action it took during its previous turn. The enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure, during its next turn it must repeat that action pattern if legally possible, but it chooses all legal targets and paths; it spends no limited resources and cannot be forced to harm itself. A player-controlled creature instead, on a failed save, loses its Reaction and must choose either repeat one ordinary non-resource action type from its prior turn or have Speed reduced to 0 until turn end. Allies retain memory of all temporal echoes. This Final never creates more than one additional full Action for any creature in a round. There are only two options in this Final; after using both once, remaining rounds provide only the printed temporal presence, without another echo. An echoed healing amount also pays 1 RC or consumes an unused per-rest healing use; a temporal copy cannot create an uncosted healing reserve.

value.name: The Spiral Opens
value.description: Once per day, open a causality spiral for 3 rounds: at start of each round, choose one — repeat last round's beneficial Revelation at no cost, or force one enemy to repeat their last turn's worst action against their allies. Allies remember all timelines.

classRecords.text: Sustained Oath spell damage/healing zones use concentration, at most three pulses, and 1 RP upkeep after the first pulse unless a priced card expressly supplies a different finite cadence. Native Oath auras retain their printed passive cadence and target cap. Final auras last their stated finite duration and include their pulses. All hard-denial effects, including compelled Actions, share the common once/source/target/encounter guard; later failures only remove Reactions and reduce Speed by half for one turn.

card.name: Lay on Hands
card.cost: All remaining Lay on Hands points; minimum 1
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in aura
card.effect: Allocate remaining points among targets, at least 1 each; restore 1 HP per point. You may instead allocate 5 points per target to end Poisoned or Frightened. Spend entire pool, cannot multiply it by recipient count, raise the dead or remove Wounds. Oathbreakers instead deal allocated necrotic damage to 3 enemies, CON half, same pool cost.

source.originalText:
Lay on Hands: Full Cleansing Wave (Level 17)
Once per rest, expend your entire Lay on Hands pool to create a wave of healing energy that affects all allies within your aura radius.

card.name: Dread Shelter
card.effect: New rank 2 Forbidden spell. Gain 2 S+M temporary HP on casting and 1 flat DR against weapon damage for duration. No recurring temp HP pulse or healing.

card.name: Desecrated Ground
card.cost: 7 RP start; 1 RP per later pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius fixed point 30 ft, up to 3 enemies
card.effect: New rank 4 Forbidden spell. Initial and each paid pulse CON save for S d6 necrotic, half success. A failed target receives 1 less HP per healing die until start of your next turn. Penalty cannot make healing negative or stack with another same-stat reduction.

card.name: Last Reproach
card.activation: Reaction after an enemy damages an ally
card.rangeAndTarget: That enemy 60 ft; one living ally in your aura
card.effect: New rank 5 Forbidden spell. Enemy WIS save for 3 S d8 necrotic, half success; ally regains S d8 HP after triggering damage. Does not revive dead or undo conditions. Uses ordinary spell strain and your Reaction.

card.name: Aura of Mercy
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
card.effect: The first time each round a selected ally receives HP healing from a finite or paid effect, add S HP. Each selected ally also reduces the first necrotic damage it takes each round by S. These benefits do not stack with another Aura of Mercy from the same source.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Mercy — allies gain increased healing received and resistance to necrotic damage

card.name: Blessing of the Meek
card.duration: Healing instantaneous; AC bonus until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. If it was below half maximum HP before this healing, it also gains +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. This spell cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or generate additional healing triggers beyond ordinary once-per-effect rules.

value.spell: Blessing of the Meek — heal + AC if HP < 50%

card.name: Grace Eternal
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies in your Oath aura
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Apply Miracle Veil to up to 3 allies in your aura without spending its short-rest use or RP. Once during this Veil for each affected ally, if damage would reduce it to 0 HP, it remains at 1 HP and immediately regains 2d8 HP. It also gains necrotic resistance until the end of its next turn. During Grace Eternal you may use Lay on Hands once without an Action, but must still spend points from your current Lay on Hands pool and may target only one creature.

originalObjects.value: Grace Eternal — once per day, Miracle Veil extends to all allies within your aura for 1 round; any ally reduced to 0 HP in that round rises to 1 HP instead, heals 2d8, and gains resistance to necrotic until end of next turn; you may Lay on Hands once as a free action during the veil.

card.name: Healing Suppression
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
card.effect: HP healing received by each selected creature is halved, rounded down. Temporary HP, damage prevention and resurrection are not healing for this effect. This suppression cannot reduce healing below 0 or convert prevented healing into damage.

originalObjects.value: Healing Suppression — all healing within aura reduced by 50%

card.name: Exsanguinate
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living creatures in your Oath aura
card.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2 S d8 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Regain HP equal to half the total actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum Paladin level+M. Undead and constructs are unaffected and cannot be used to generate healing.

originalObjects.value: Exsanguinate — drain life in large radius, heal self for damage dealt

card.name: Phoenix Rebirth
card.rangeAndTarget: One living ally in your Oath aura reduced to 0 HP
card.duration: Revival instantaneous; fire shield until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Trigger when the ally reaches 0 HP without being killed outright. It immediately regains HP equal to half its maximum, rounded down, minimum 1. Until the end of its next turn it has fire resistance. Once during that duration when a creature within melee reach damages it with a melee attack, that attacker takes 2d6 fire damage. Phoenix Rebirth removes no Wounds and cannot restore a creature destroyed beyond recovery.

value.spell: Phoenix Rebirth — when ally in aura drops to 0 HP, revive to half max HP with fire shield (resist fire, 2d6 fire to melee attackers) once per combat per ally

card.name: Death Touch — Blighting Blood
card.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature within melee reach; its occupied space
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; blighted space until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; terrain rider once per turn
card.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared points and blight the target's space until the start of your next turn. The first hostile creature other than the original target that enters or starts its turn in that space takes S necrotic damage. The patch creates no corpse, healing or resource trigger.

card.name: Scorch the Sanctified
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
card.effect: Selected enemies cannot regain HP from passive regeneration. At the start of each selected enemy's turn it makes a Charisma save. On failure, one temporary beneficial magical effect on it chosen by the Director from eligible non-innate effects is suppressed until the start of its next turn. Immunities, class engines, permanent traits and attunement are never suppressed.

originalObjects.value: Scorch the Sanctified — remove buffs; block regeneration

card.name: Scorch the Sanctified — Blasphemous Word
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: Instantaneous; suppressed effect until end of next turn
card.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking S d6 fire plus S d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A failing target also has one eligible temporary beneficial spell or regeneration effect suppressed until the end of its next turn. You may knowingly include allies among the targets; the effect offers them no protection.

originalObjects.value: Scorch the Sanctified — AoE purge that harms allies

card.name: Lifeleech Bloom Aura
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets and one damage type at start of each turn
card.effect: Selected enemies cannot regain HP from passive regeneration. Also choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, radiant or thunder. A selected enemy's resistance to that chosen type is suppressed while it remains selected in the aura; immunity is never suppressed.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Ancients

originalObjects.value: Lifeleech Bloom — remove regeneration and resistance

card.displayPath: Withering Grove — Oath of the Ancients Oathbreaker

card.name: Lifeleech Bloom
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living creatures or plant creatures in your Oath aura
card.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2 S d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. You regain HP equal to half the total actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum Paladin level+M. You may include willing allies among the targets, but they receive no protection and cannot be reduced below 1 HP by this Blasphemous Word. Constructs and ordinary unattended plants provide no healing.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 11; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Ancients

originalObjects.value: Lifeleech Bloom — drain vitality from plants and allies

card.displayPath: Withering Grove — Oath of the Ancients Oathbreaker

card.name: Dirge of Passage
card.rangeAndTarget: Memories of up to 2 fallen allies; creatures in your Oath aura
card.effect: For 2 rounds maintain two Final Vigil memories simultaneously and gain both selected benefits. Up to three selected hostile undead in your aura take an additional S radiant damage from your first damaging Paladin feature each round and cannot regain HP. Living allies in your aura gain +2 on death saves. No spirit gains its own turn, resources, spellcasting or complete former statistics. This flat rider replaces blanket damage vulnerability and never doubles a whole attack.

originalObjects.value: Dirge of Passage — once per day, Final Vigil can channel two fallen allies simultaneously for 2 rounds; undead in aura suffer vulnerability to radiant and cannot benefit from healing, and survivors gain +2 death saves while either spirit is active.

card.name: Dirge of Ruin Aura
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
card.effect: Selected living creatures cannot be returned from death while inside the aura, and HP healing they receive is reduced by S+M, minimum 0. This never converts healing into damage and cannot retroactively reverse a resurrection completed before the creature entered the aura.

originalObjects.value: Dirge of Ruin — block resurrection and healing

card.name: Dirge of Ruin
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; healing block until end of next turn
card.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2 S d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A failing target cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. This does not prevent temporary HP or remove healing already received.

originalObjects.value: Dirge of Ruin — necrotic wave that prevents healing

card.name: Crown of Embers
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies in your Oath aura
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Selected allies reduce the first damage they take before the start of your next turn by S. During this period you may redirect damage from one selected ally to yourself without using a Reaction, once total for the Crown, up to Paladin level+M damage. Redirected damage retains type and cannot be redirected again. The Crown grants no healing by itself.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 11; Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Crown of Embers — team-wide DR + damage redirection (1/rest)

card.name: Burden Shared
card.activation: Reaction when an ally takes damage
card.rangeAndTarget: Triggering ally and up to two other willing allies in your aura
card.effect: After applying the original target’s defenses once, divide up to Paladin level+M of the remaining damage among the willing recipients as you choose; each recipient must explicitly accept its amount. The original ally takes the remainder. Transferred damage keeps its type and cannot be reduced again, redirected, reflected or trigger healing/resources. This uses the one redirection event per round.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 9; Oath of the Martyr King

value.spell: Burden Shared — distribute damage among willing allies

card.name: Throne’s Grace
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to three allies in your aura
card.effect: Your Lay on Hands and touch-range Paladin healing can target selected allies anywhere in your current aura with clear line of effect. Normal activation, pool/RP costs, rank gates and use limits remain. Rolled healing you grant them adds 1 HP per die, maximum S+M additional HP per effect; pool-point healing adds no dice bonus. Selected allies gain +1 on death saves. The spell itself restores no HP.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 13; Oath of the Martyr King

value.spell: Throne's Grace — Lay on Hands and healing you grant reach full aura radius for 3 rounds; allies in aura heal +1 HP per die and gain +1 death saves while the grace persists

card.name: Crown Undying
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three selected allies in your aura
card.effect: For three rounds apply Crown of Embers protection without consuming its short-rest use. Selected allies reduce their first damage each round by S and gain +1 on saves; this save bonus does not stack with Aura of the Crown. You may redirect from up to two selected allies each round, at most Paladin level+M damage total per round, without a Reaction. Original-target defenses apply once; redirected damage cannot be reduced again. Each protected ally then heals half the damage you actually absorbed for it, rounded down, maximum S+M per ally per round. This is a finite Final healing exception, cannot heal you, cannot exceed maximum HP, and cannot trigger another redirection or heal-copy chain. It does not reset the daily Lay on Hands pool.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 20; Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Crown Undying — once per day, Crown of Embers lasts 3 rounds without concentration; damage you redirect heals the ally for half absorbed, allies in aura gain +1 saves while the crown persists, and you may redirect from two allies per round.

card.name: Crownshatter Decree Aura
card.path: Oathbreaker — Oath of the Martyr King
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three selected enemies in your aura
card.effect: A selected enemy receives HP healing only if it has taken actual damage from a meaningful hostile creature since the start of its previous regular turn. If it has not, that healing restores 0 HP; its source still spends its normal costs. Temporary HP, stabilization and resurrection are not HP healing for this restriction. This aura never creates damage, transfers healing or reverses recovery that already resolved.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Crownshatter Decree — damage required for healing

card.displayPath: Usurper's Crown — Oath of the Martyr King Oathbreaker

classRecords.text: Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

card.name: Living Pulse
card.effect: You may pay 1 RP to regain 2 HP. Does not trigger when Downed or incapacitated, cannot exceed maximum and never counts as another healing spell. Replaces unlimited passive regeneration with a finite cost.

source.originalText: Living Pulse: Regenerate 2 HP per round while in natural terrain.

card.name: Healing Briar
card.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft-radius natural-ground zone within 30 ft; 3 allies/pulse
card.effect: On start heal 1d8+M per chosen living ally; on next 2 turns Bonus Action+1 RP repeats pulse. Maximum 3 pulses; no passive additional entry healing and no Wound removal.

source.originalText: Healing Briar: Establish a healing zone that restores health to allies within it.

classRecords.text: Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

On your turn you may spend Bonus Action to move one totem up to 15 ft along unobstructed ground, remaining within 60 ft. This competes with healing maintenance, companion commands and advanced flasks. Moving an aura over a creature cannot trigger its once/round effect repeatedly. Totem destruction creates no resource return. Once per round, the first ordinary spell cast while inside your own active totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0; no RP reduction.

card.name: Extended Totem Duration
card.cost: 0; full upkeep for extra Renewal pulse
card.effect: Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.

source.originalText: Extended Totem Duration: Totems last for an additional round.

card.name: Spirit Cache
card.rangeAndTarget: One flask/to-tem effect you directly used
card.effect: Store its profile, not an active copy. On a later turn use normal Action/Bonus Action and pay all RP and a new flask unit or full totem cost to repeat it. Add 1d6 to one numerical damage/heal amount; no copy of refund/limited use.

source.originalText: Spirit Cache: Store one flask or totem effect to recast later (once per encounter).

card.name: Totem Pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
card.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

source.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

card.name: Spirit Saturation
card.effect: Waive its 2 RP placement cost once. Still use Action, concentration, capacity and any added costs. Cannot create a healing totem or be cached/refunded to generate more free casts.

source.originalText: Spirit Saturation: Gain one free totem cast per combat (level 9).

card.name: Echo Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Adjacent empty space within 5 ft of newly placed totem
card.effect: Create a weak echo anchor of that totem. It counts toward capacity; if no space in capacity, cannot create it. Its radius 10 ft and numerical bonuses/healing are half, rounded down. Shared concentration/upkeep and same-name nonstacking prevent double healing.

source.originalText: Echo Totem: Automatically cast a second, weaker totem when placing your primary totem.

card.name: Blight Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Totem within 30 ft; 15 ft aura affecting all creatures
card.effect: HP healing received inside aura is halved, rounding down, including allies and you. Nonstacking with another healing reduction; temporary HP unaffected. This totem has standard object stats and grants no free damage/healing.

source.originalText: Blight Totem: Place a corrupted totem that reduces all healing in its area by 50%.

card.name: Blood Curse
card.effect: CON save or Bleed 1d4 necrotic at start of each of next 3 turns. Action plus successful Medicine check against class DC ends it; magical healing also permits an immediate CON save to end. Never permanently unhealable; no repeated stacking.

source.originalText: Blood Curse: Inflict a bleeding wound that cannot be healed normally.

card.name: Elder Spirit Accord — new Hero capstone
card.effect: When starting Elemental Chorus, Omen Loop or Bloodroot Trail, reduce its RP cost by 3, minimum 1, and add M to one damage/healing roll from that use. You must know that ability and still spend its own limited use. If you do not know it, instead reduce one known Hero technique's RP cost by 3, minimum 1. No extra duration, flask, totem, command or repeated cast.

classRecords.text: Base 1–2, Commander Arch 3–9, then Champion/Artillerist/Tyrant Hero 10–20. Palisade 5 is automatic; Intercepting Shot has minimum 6 and Fortify Zone 9. Other cards require selection. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. At 20 gain the new Final Command below, clearly a playtest addition. No spell or sustained technique may be used to obtain infinite ammunition, structures, actions or permanent healing.

card.name: Exsanguinate
card.effect: At start of your regular turn with a hostile bleeding enemy nearby you may pay 1 RP to regain S HP. No multiplying by enemy count or healing while incapacitated; not an ordinary spell or Dissonance-generating technique.

source.originalText: Exsanguinate: Gain 1 HP per round for each bleeding target within 3 tiles.

classRecords.text: Base 1–2, Mechanist Arch 3–9, then Artificer/Techsmith/Warmachine Hero 10–20. Upgrade Slot 5 is automatic; Sentry and Net minimum 6, Remote Detonation 9. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. Mech Overdrive 20 is automatic: once/long rest when deploying choose one device whose duration becomes encounter end (maximum 1 minute), still command dependent, slot limited and destructible. No infinite pulses: healing effects keep original pulse cap and all per-use costs remain. Protected magic interface: once per short rest, as a Bonus Action route up to 2 current Dissonance into one of your active devices within 30 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. Repair with an Action and 1 RP using Field Repair, or with 10 minutes and 1 RP using tinkers tools. No RP is created and no Refrain counter resets.

card.name: Field Repair
card.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

card.name: Efficient Power Cells
card.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

card.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
card.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

card.name: Repair Pulse
card.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
card.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

card.name: Restoration Field
card.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
card.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

card.name: Mech Overdrive
card.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
card.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.

source.originalText: You begin with one deployable slot and gain additional slots as you level up. At level 20, you gain Mech Overdrive, allowing one device to become permanent for the duration of a battle.

card.name: Regenerative Mutation
card.cost: Spend healing amount from Mutation Recovery Reserve
card.duration: While at least one mutation is active in a real encounter
card.frequency: Once at the start of each regular turn
card.effect: Regenerative Mutation. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, if at least one mutation is active and you are below maximum HP, regain S+M HP. This regeneration functions only during a real encounter, cannot restore the dead or remove Wounds, and cannot be increased by remaining in initiative without meaningful opposition. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal only up to remaining reserve.

source.originalText: Regenerative Mutation: Heal 5% of your maximum health each round while at least one mutation is active.

card.name: Cellular Reconstruction
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn, then instantaneous recovery
card.effect: Cellular Reconstruction. Enter stasis until the start of your next regular turn: your Speed becomes 0, you cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions, and attacks against you have advantage. At the start of your next turn regain 3d8 + M HP and end Poisoned plus one mundane or magical disease that does not explicitly require a special cure. This removes no Wounds and cannot function while dead.

source.originalText: Cellular Reconstruction: Enter a brief stasis where your body rapidly heals and purges toxins or diseases.

card.name: Pain Empowerment
card.effect: Pain Empowerment. For every full 10% of your maximum HP currently missing, add +1 damage to one weapon or natural-weapon damage roll on each of your turns, maximum +5. Determine the bonus immediately before the chosen damage roll. Healing can reduce the bonus during the encounter. It does not increase mutation retaliation, ongoing damage or area effects.

source.originalText: Pain Empowerment: Gain +5% damage for each 10% of health you are missing.

card.name: Primed
card.effect: Enhance one active mutation's numeric benefit for the turn: +1 to one AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage bonus; +5 feet to one movement/reach bonus; or +1 damage/healing to one mutation-generated roll. Primed never increases duration, targets, immunity or resource generation.

source.originalText: | Primed | Deal 50% of max HP as damage | Active mutations gain +25% effectiveness |

card.name: Transcendent
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: At Warrior 12+, the first time this encounter you cross 100% Brutality Progress or reach stored BT 4, activate all equipped mutations until start of your next regular turn. No serum profile or immediate healing trigger is granted. This is one total pulse, never a permanent BT 4 concurrency increase. At end choose active mutations up to normal limit, with their original remaining durations; others become dormant.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 12; 100% Brutality Progress or BT 4 with raised cap; new explicit level gate

source.originalText: | Transcendent | Deal 100% of max HP as damage | All mutations active simultaneously for 1 round |

card.name: Bloodthick Node
card.duration: While active during a real encounter
card.frequency: Once at start of each regular turn
card.effect: Regain HP equal to current BT, maximum 3 HP per turn or 4 with Stack Overflow. No healing occurs outside a real encounter and it removes no Wounds. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Bloodthick Node | Heal 1 HP per BT stack each round |

card.name: Rapid Coagulation
card.duration: While active during a real encounter
card.effect: If you did not move during your previous turn, regain 2 HP at the start of your current turn. This does not function outside a real encounter. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Rapid Coagulation | Gain Regeneration 2 if you haven't moved this round |

card.name: Bio-Stabilizer
card.effect: While at least two mutations are active, Bloodthick Node heals 1 additional HP on each of its valid encounter-only regeneration pulses.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 4; Bloodthick Node equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Bio-Stabilizer | Bloodthick Node | +1 regen while under the effect of 2+ mutations |

classRecords.text: ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.

card.name: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock)
card.effect: Infernal Pact — Gravebrand. Tags: hero, necromancer, infernal, necrotic, dark-content. This card can be selected only after completing the campaign's Infernal Pact quest and its dark-trauma check-in. Mark one creature. At the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save; on failure it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to the actual damage dealt, maximum S+M; success ends Gravebrand. Gravebrand ignores necrotic resistance but not immunity. While you possess this Pact, Corpse Harvest and Auto-Raise may also treat Fiend corpses as eligible; other creature types remain ineligible.

source.originalText: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock): Grants Gravebrand: 1d6 necrotic per round, heals caster, overrides corpse resistance
